ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 4:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity central region covering ~80% of the fluke surface; low-intensity continuous band along the trailing edge and distal tips; multiple discrete low-intensity focal spots (ovals) distributed asymmetrically across the medial zones of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with an internal pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 12% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke structure.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations across the majority of the trailing edge boundary; high-amplitude, irregular jagged topography (tissue void) on the right distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve; concave curvature originating at the median notch transitioning to broad convexity toward the terminal tips of the lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of ~12 discrete, circular to oval low-intensity pixel clusters (5-15 pixel diameter) consistent with surface scarring, primarily located on the lower-medial sections of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions; distinct vertical rake marks on the left lobe and diagonal scratches on the right lobe near the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and jagged scarring on the terminal edge of the right lobe; dense dark pigmentation cluster localized at the apex of the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense cluster of micro-focal dark spots concentrated near the hinge point of the fluke lobes.
